name: Machine Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit in a lever lat pulldown machine with the thigh pad locked comfortably over your legs and grip the overhead handles firmly with an overhand grip.
Sit tall with a slight natural lean back and let your arms extend overhead to stretch your lats.
Pull the handles smoothly downward toward your shoulders by driving your elbows down and inward beside your ribs.
Return the handles slowly overhead to full arm extension without letting the lever arms drop abruptly.
tips: Keep your chest proud and shoulder blades moving down as you pull.
Avoid using your body weight to jerk the handles downward.
